en: Fixed Esc not stopping computer use between actions on macOS when Claude Code's window or an app you allowed is in front; an Esc meant for that app's popup now stops computer use instead
zh: 修复了在 macOS 上，当 Claude Code 的窗口或你允许的应用位于前台时，Esc 无法在 computer use 的各操作之间将其停止的问题；原本发给该应用弹窗的 Esc 现在会改为停止 computer use
